scripts.mobile: concurrently -k -n convex,agent,expo -c cyan,magenta,yellow --handle-input "bun run backend" "bun run agent" "bun run --cwd apps/mobile ios"
scripts.mobile:chatgpt: concurrently -k -n convex,agent,expo -c cyan,magenta,yellow --handle-input "bun run backend" "bun run agent" "EXPO_PUBLIC_AGENT_URL=http://localhost:3583 bun run --cwd apps/mobile ios"
scripts.mobile:chatgpt:pi: concurrently -k -n convex,agent,expo -c cyan,magenta,yellow --handle-input "bun run backend" "bun run --cwd packages/agent dev:chatgpt" "EXPO_PUBLIC_AGENT_URL=http://localhost:3583 bun run --cwd apps/mobile ios"
scripts.mobile:android: concurrently -k -n convex,agent,expo -c cyan,magenta,green --handle-input "bun run backend" "bun run agent" "bun run --cwd apps/mobile android"
scripts.bee:dev: bun run bee:configure && concurrently -k --success first -n convex,agent,cli -c cyan,magenta,yellow --handle-input --default-input-target cli "bun run backend" "bun run agent" "until curl -sS --connect-timeout 1 http://localhost:3583/ >/dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 1; done; BEE_CLI_INTERACTIVE=1 bun run bee"
